global: This is a bowl of spicy ramen with a rich, reddish broth. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and chopped green onions, it sits in a white bowl against a vibrant red background, illuminated by warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Vibrant red table surface with smooth, slightly reflective texture and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, subtle red patterned rim, smooth curved surface.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, green onions, and tofu, rich reddish-brown, glossy surface, textured with ingredients.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded bowl shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: golden-brown, tender-looking, slightly curled, with visible fat marbling and seared surface texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-yellow, with fibrous texture, irregular elongated shapes, and faint green specks on their surfaces.
